dispositions.rationale: Correct: the exemption is a conjunction of ownership and notice.

dispositions.quote_before: Single-family homes and condos are exempt from AB 1482 only if the tenant received the required written exemption notice.
dispositions.quote_after: The single-family-home/condo exemption also requires qualifying ownership: no REIT, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, plus the required written exemption notice. Notice alone does not establish eligibility (Civil Code §1947.12(d)(5)).

dispositions.quote_before: The same math works for any date: count back 30 days for personal service, or 35 if you mail the notice.
dispositions.quote_after: For an otherwise lawful increase, use at least 30 days when the cumulative increase is 10% or less over the preceding 12 months; use 90 days above 10%, measured from the lowest rent in that period. First-class mailing within California adds five days; mailing from elsewhere can require longer. November 25 and December 1 are conservative planning targets for a January 1 increase that qualifies for 30-day notice.
